entries.f4dd647c6f6aa4f5: The company has set out a vision for 2032, the year it marks the 50th anniversary of its founding, titled 'C.S. LUMBER VISION 2032,' and states that it aims to become a group of companies that, while keeping the precut business as its foundation without being confined to that framework, creates diverse sources of revenue and continues to expand and grow. In the precut business, the company will pursue strengthening its proposal capabilities for siding (exterior wall material) precut processing, proposals of 'integrated materials and erection' that combine structural timber with frame erection work, and labor savings and higher yield through renewal of its precut processing machines. In the construction contracting business, the company will work on receiving orders for large wooden facilities and expanding its area, and in the real estate leasing business it will work on securing stable rental income by acquiring income-producing properties and candidate sites for sale.
